checks: actual HTTP rejects a guest, a mismatched expected account and a mismatched profile
authenticated creation/replay retains one owned community and its list entry
private discovery/direct-ID join does not expose or admit the nonmember
current invitation admits once, old invitation is rejected, and a member cannot regenerate it
real channel creation/listing excludes private owner channels from the member
member text send, physical read and identical replay preserve one unchanged message
owner permission changes deny and then restore actual member sends
leaving revokes the same message read and new sends while preserving the owner and history
public discovery hides invitation secrets and direct-ID join/replay/leave update membership once
scope: Actual local Firebase Auth/HTTP callables and SDK Firestore rules. No forged admissions, cloud policy/provider changes or production data. Not browser UI, voice or physical-device proof.
